eyesim plot colours

eyesim_colours.Rd

Named colour roles used by every eyesim plot. Reference (encoding) and source (recall) gaze keep the same colours in every panel; time, density and correspondence each have one ramp or colour.

Usage

eyesim_colours(role = NULL)

Arguments

role

Optional character vector of role names. `NULL` returns all.

Value

A named character vector of hex colours.

See also

Other visualization: anim_scanpath(), element_text_wrap(), plot.eye_density(), plot.fixation_group(), scale_fill_eyesim_density(), theme_eyesim()

Examples

eyesim_colours()
#>      reference         source            raw correspondence     diagnostic 
#>      "#1B2A41"      "#C23B4B"      "#8A8F98"      "#5B4FCF"      "#3F4A5A" 
#>            ink          muted           rule           grid 
#>      "#1F2328"      "#5A6270"      "#D5D9DE"      "#ECEEF1" 
eyesim_colours(c("reference", "source"))
#> reference    source 
#> "#1B2A41" "#C23B4B"
